description: Call BEFORE a wallet signs or sends anything. Decodes a transaction, EIP-712 request (Permit, Permit2, EIP-3009, Seaport), EIP-7702 delegation or x402 payment into plain English and returns SAFE / CAUTION / DANGER with risk flags (unlimited or EOA approvals, setApprovalForAll, fake USDC domains, x402 overpay / wrong payTo, OFAC SDN). Free offline preview by default (verdict, summary, flag codes). With SIGNCHECK_X402_PRIVATE_KEY set, returns the full paid check (reasons, on-chain facts, simulation) from https://api.youraitools.co/signcheck/v1/check, paying $0.015 USDC on Base per check over x402. Informational pre-sign check from public data and static rules, not a security guarantee or financial advice. A SAFE verdict means no known-bad pattern was found.

chain.description: base (default), ethereum, base-sepolia or a chain id

payment_payload.description: x402 payment about to be sent: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE / X-PAYMENT (base64) or JSON
